thread:
akash: Heads up — after landing the smoothing change in the rate limiter (PR #8421) we see sustained queue depth on eval-runner-*/shard queues and a retry storm on small evals.
lina: saw it on the dashboard too. latency p95 up ~300ms and token throughput dropped. link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/eval-runner
maria: logs show lots of immediate retries from runner dispatcher: `Retrying request: shard not available` — seems like backpressure propagated rather than absorbed.
jake: quick hypothesis: smoothing shifted allowance to a shard-global token bucket, so hot shards hog burst credit and other shards starve. that would cause head-of-line blocking and retries.
akash: exactly. before we had per-worker buckets + global limiter. smoothing merged them and we lost isolation.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1342. alerted on eval-runner queue length > 5000.
lina: can we hotfix by reverting the smoothing? or do per-shard smoothing instead of global? reverting is fastest.
maria: revert is safe for now. but we should add a per-shard smoothing approach and test it under skewed workloads.
jake: proposed quick config patch to limit per-shard burst and add jitter on retry backoff:
```
rate_limiter:
  mode: per_shard
  burst_tokens: 100
  replenish_rate_per_sec: 20
  retry_backoff:
    base_ms: 50
    max_ms: 2000
    jitter: true
```
akash: also add a histogram metric for "rate_limiter.per_shard_starved_seconds" and an exported gauge for "active_buckets" so we can see starvation.
devxbot: CI job failing: //eng-ml/eval-runner:throughput-smoke flaky — timeout increases when smoothing is on.
maria: marked flaky in CI and added a TODO to re-enable after fix (pytest xfail).
jake: I'll open a revert PR now and follow up with per-shard smoothing PR. assigning to @jake. will also add the histogram metric and update dashboards.
lina: can someone add a short integration test that simulates a 80/20 shard skew? CI needs a deterministic harness for this.
akash: @lina please add the harness. @jake please coordinate on the PRs. we should aim to revert in the next 30 min if the revert looks clean.
sre-bot: rolling back config on dedicated cluster started.
akash: thanks. postmortem action items: revert smoothing, add per-shard limiter design doc, add skewed-shard test, add retry jitter, add metrics. I'll create a GH issue and assign owners.
maria: GH issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/r/issue/4532 — assigned to jake/lina.
jake: on it. will post PR links here.
lina: added skeleton test in //eng-ml/eval-runner/tests/test_shard_skew.py — simulates worker counts and verifies no starvation.
akash: great. keep updates short here. once rollback completes we'll monitor graphs and decide on next steps. :thumbsup:
